steps.question: Which experimental group does sample_03 belong to, and how extreme is its separation from the other 9 muscle samples in the treated-vs-control 5-vs-5 design on PCA and sample-distance metrics?
acceptance_criteria: Reports sample_03's condition label (treated or control) from metadata.csv
Reports variance-stabilized PCA (PC1/PC2 with % variance explained) and a sample-to-sample distance matrix/heatmap for all 10 samples
Reports library size, gene detection count, and any other size-factor or count-distribution metric for sample_03 relative to the other 9 samples
Produces a clear recommendation basis (not a decision) on whether sample_03 is a technical outlier vs a biological extreme of its group

caveats: This result may be distorted by sample_03; do not present it as the final answer without the sensitivity comparison in T2S2

steps.question: Which genes are differentially expressed between treated (n=5) and control (n=5) muscle samples using all 10 samples, unpaired single-batch design?
acceptance_criteria: Runs DESeq2 with design ~ condition on raw integer counts from counts.csv joined to metadata.csv condition labels
Reports full results table with log2FoldChange, p-value, and BH-adjusted p-value for every gene
Applies independent filtering and reports the number of genes at padj < 0.05 and at padj < 0.1
Produces an MA plot and a volcano plot annotated with top genes

steps.name: Sensitivity DESeq2 differential expression excluding sample_03
caveats: Excluding a sample drops one group to n=4, further reducing power — report this honestly rather than treating the smaller-n result as strictly better
Do not cherry-pick whichever result gives more significant genes; report both and the overlap
steps.question: Which genes remain differentially expressed between treated and control muscle samples when the outlier sample_03 (identified in T1S1) is excluded, and how does this gene list compare to the full-cohort result?
acceptance_criteria: Runs DESeq2 with design ~ condition on the 9 remaining samples after excluding sample_03, using the same raw counts and metadata
Reports full results table with log2FoldChange, padj for every gene, and the resulting group sizes (e.g. 4 vs 5 or 5 vs 4 depending on sample_03's group)
Directly compares the padj<0.05 gene set from this run against the full-cohort run from T2S1: overlap count, genes gained, genes lost
Flags any gene whose significance call flips between the two runs as sample_03-dependent

steps.name: Pathway enrichment on the outlier-robust DE gene set
caveats: WikiPathways gene sets use HGNC symbols matching the counts.csv gene symbol column, but confirm the symbol matching rate before interpreting results
With ~12000 background genes and a small DE list, enrichment power is limited; report gene set sizes and overlap counts alongside p-values
steps.question: Which WikiPathways human pathways are enriched among genes differentially expressed between treated and control muscle samples in the sample_03-excluded (robust) DESeq2 result from T2S2?
acceptance_criteria: Uses a human WikiPathways gene set collection confirmed present in the environment reference store
Runs over-representation or GSEA-style enrichment using the ranked or thresholded gene list from T2S2 (padj<0.05 gene set, or full ranked list by stat for GSEA)
Reports enriched pathway names, gene overlap, and BH-adjusted enrichment p-values
Notes explicitly if the reference pathway set is missing/unusable at run time and reports enrichment as skipped rather than fabricating a result

plan.title: Muscle treated vs control DE with outlier-aware sensitivity
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is a bulk RNA-seq experiment (Salmon-derived gene-level counts, 12000 genes x 10 samples in muscle tissue) with a balanced 5-vs-5 treated/control design, unpaired, single batch. The data profile flags sample_03 as a clear outlier on PCA and the sample-distance heatmap, separating from every other sample regardless of its group label. This is a real threat to the primary DE contrast: if sample_03 is treated or control, an unmodeled outlier can dominate dispersion estimation and either mask true signal or manufacture false positives via a handful of extreme counts. Rather than silently dropping the sample or silently keeping it, the plan runs QC characterization first to establish which group sample_03 belongs to and how extreme it is, then runs the primary DESeq2 differential expression twice — once on the full n=5/5 design and once with sample_03 excluded (if its own group retains n=4, the design is still assessable, unpaired, single batch) — so the synthesizer can report which DE genes are robust to the exclusion versus which depend on that single sample. Enrichment analysis (WikiPathways human gene sets, confirmed present in refs) is run on the robust gene set from the sensitivity-checked, exclusion-based result, since a 12-gene, n=10 count matrix is too small and too outlier-sensitive to trust an enrichment built on a potentially confounded full-cohort DE list without that check.
